title: docs(authentication): the allowed IP ranges row does not say that Setup now shows the address the server judges for you
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cbvcmv8YWFhFJwzjKL

Filing gate: ② a follow-up the seat committed to in the #30398 landing record 6659838213 ("a one-line `authentication.mdx` mention follows once the ui shows the address"), now due: the ui half #30313 landed in PR #30540 (`b6f4c0e8b7`, landing 6663057589, notice 6663097135 on the seat mailbox). ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p3 (docs only).
Dedupe: `client-address authentication.mdx`, `judged client address docs`. Nearest are #30398 (closed, the read) and #30313 (closed, the console note). **New.**

## What is missing

`content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` L622 (the `allowed_ip_ranges` row) explains which address is judged, and that a save leaving out your own address is refused. It does not say where an administrator can see that address. Since #30398 the server serves it at `GET /api/v1/auth/admin/client-address` (`{ clientAddress, trustProxy }`, platform admin, `no-store`), and since #30313 Setup's Allowed IP ranges row shows it as a note.

## Ask

One sentence in that row (or in "Saving, clearing and lockout recovery" if it reads better there): Setup shows the address the server judges for the current request, read from `GET /api/v1/auth/admin/client-address`, so an administrator can include it before saving. Docs only; no code. Changeset: none needed for docs-only (follow the repo's rule).
